stories.title: Attacks and blockade enforcement around Hormuz
stories.what: Attacks on commercial shipping in and around the Strait of Hormuz have continued into November, with a Sinokor VLCC struck and four crew injured. Trade press reports continued disruption to shipping through the strait, and Greenpeace has identified 540 possible oil spills across the Gulf, Hormuz and Arabian Sea since the US-Iran war began on 28 February.
stories.why_it_matters: Hull strikes and crew-safety concerns raise war-risk premiums for Arabian Gulf liftings and shrink the pool of willing owners; pollution on this scale adds a clean-up and port-state dimension for vessels trading the region.
stories.latest: Greenpeace mapped 540 possible oil spills with a cumulative slick footprint across the Gulf and Arabian Sea; press attributed Thursday's $1/bbl oil rise partly to continued Hormuz disruption.
sources: Gulf war leaves toxic legacy that could last decades
Oil Prices Rise $1/Barrel As Disruptions Continue in Strait of Hormuz

stories.title: Sanctions and evasion in the shadow fleet
stories.what: US sanctions have expanded across Cuban maritime entities and Iranian false-flag registry networks, while the dark fleet is described as a parallel fleet that has tripled since 2022. The US Treasury may now allow companies to buy sanctioned vessels and return them to legitimate trade case by case.
stories.why_it_matters: Registry fraud and designations force charterers and insurers to re-verify documents and positions; a licensing route back to legitimate trade could return tonnage to the compliant fleet.

stories.title: Russian diesel flows and export restrictions
stories.what: A reported US-Russia arrangement on extra diesel for the US market has met political opposition, while Russia has extended a ban on most diesel exports to end-January. A tanker carrying Russian diesel that had signalled the US turned around off the US East Coast.
stories.why_it_matters: Diesel export restrictions and any reopened Atlantic route reshape clean product tanker ton-miles and MR and LR employment.

stories.title: Wave of newbuilding orders
stories.what: COSCO Shipping Development has ordered 16 VLCCs worth 13.43 billion yuan ($2.01bn), and Teekay Tankers has ordered four more newbuildings, lifting its programme to six ships worth $525.9m. Shipbroker Intermodal reports contracting activity remains elevated across both wet and dry sectors, and Volare Shipping has announced the acquisition of a VLCC newbuild.
stories.why_it_matters: Large orderbook additions change future crude, product and dry bulk supply and shape secondhand values and recycling decisions.
stories.latest: Volare Shipping announced a VLCC newbuild acquisition and trade press reported newbuilding contracting remains elevated in both wet and dry markets.
sources: Volare Shipping Ltd.: Acquisition of VLCC newbuild

stories.title: US port fees on Chinese-built and Chinese-operated ships
stories.what: The US administration has formally extended its suspension of port fees targeting Chinese-built and Chinese-operated vessels for another two months while trade talks continue.
stories.why_it_matters: The fees, if reinstated, would change the cost of deploying Chinese-built tonnage into US trades and affect chartering preferences across sectors.

stories.title: Attacks on shipping in the Black Sea and Baltic
stories.what: A Greek container ship sank after being hit by naval drones off Bulgaria, and Russia says its forces hit three cargo vessels it claims carried military goods for Ukraine. Finland's military said it detected a strike on a Russian warship in the Baltic Sea on Wednesday, while describing the regional security situation as stable.
stories.why_it_matters: Strikes on ships and port infrastructure threaten grain and dry bulk loadings and add insurance and routing costs for any vessel calling in the region.
stories.latest: Finland detected a strike on a Russian warship in the Baltic Sea, with no confirmed casualties and the security situation described as stable.
sources: Finland Detects Strike on Baltic Sea Russian Warship
